newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FRENCH PLAYERS SEEK IMPROVED TOURNAMENT PAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRENCH PLAYERS SEEK IMPROVED TOURNAMENT PAY.

text.p: France's national team players have protested at the 40,000 francs ($8,000) per match they are being offered for their World Cup warm-up tournament in June.
The players expressed their disappointment with the French federation's offer before Wednesday's night's 2-1 home win over the Netherlands in a friendly international.

There will be further talks between the two parties when France meet Sweden at home on April 2 with the players looking for a higher sum for each appearance in the four-team Tournoi de France which also involves Brazil, Italy and England.
